about: The data release: the chart's records, the stored story texts (stories/) and translations (translations/). A new release gets the next version (YYYY.MM, or YYYY.MM.N for a second release in a month) and an entry at the top of `releases`, with its line in data/README.md (Changes).

releases.notes: First release with stored stories: the English Wikipedia text of every story, read 29 October 2026, and 4,237 Slovenian translations, both served per region next to the page.
